links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All chatbots exceeded the recommended readability level, suitable for readers at or above 10th-grade level; Gemini significantly more readable (p<0.05); none met standards.
links.quote: All chatbots generated responses exceeding the recommended readability level, making them suitable for readers at or above the 10th-grade level.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot patient-education responses versus sixth-grade recommendation
links.effect: All three chatbots exceeded the sixth-grade target, requiring 10th-grade level or above; none met recommended readability standards for patient education materials.
links.quote: None of the chatbots met the recommended readability standards for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, quality, and readability of three commercial LLMs answering FAQs about root canal retreatment without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
